response.sql: SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(CASE WHEN li.derived_product_cost <> 0 THEN li.derived_total_cost / li.derived_product_cost END) AS average_cost_ratio, COUNT(li.invoice_number) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices AS i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS li ON li.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, i.invoice_number ASC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Invoices with no line items are eligible; their average ratio is NULL. Ratios with a zero or NULL denominator are excluded from the average.

alternatives.interpretation: Show only invoices that have at least one line item.
alternatives.sql: SELECT li.invoice_number, AVG(CASE WHEN li.derived_product_cost <> 0 THEN li.derived_total_cost / li.derived_product_cost END) AS average_cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS li GROUP BY li.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, li.invoice_number ASC LIMIT 10;
